text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"mkdir -p /tmp/exposed-entity-design-sol"}));
text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /tmp/exposed-entity-design-sol/design.md
+# Entity details candidate
+
+## Usage (caller's view)
+
+Search results expose stable identity: MPs use Parliament's numeric ID; funders use their stored UUID. An MP name links to `/members/123?q=John&strictness=1`, a funder name to `/funders/<uuid>?q=John&strictness=1`. These are ordinary anchors supporting refresh, new tabs, and browser Back. Each detail page also provides a search link carrying only `q` and `strictness`.
+
+```rust
+// HTTP handlers parse path values into domain IDs, then request one complete page.
+let details = state.entity_details_service.member(member_id).await?;
+Ok(ApiSuccess::new(StatusCode::OK, MemberDetailsResponse::from(details)))
+let details = state.entity_details_service.funder(funder_id).await?;
+Ok(ApiSuccess::new(StatusCode::OK, FunderDetailsResponse::from(details)))
+```
+
+```ts
+// DetailPage.svelte owns its request lifetime; transport never returns unchecked JSON.
+const details = await getMemberDetails(route.memberId, controller.signal);
+// Funder rendering traverses currencies first: each has its own party totals/ranking.
+for (const section of details.currencies) renderCurrencySection(section);
+```
+
+## Problem
+
+The search UI currently drops entity IDs and has no detail navigation. Stored declarations contain nullable dates and funding facts; monetary totals must retain exact amounts, duplicate occurrences, and currency distinctions. Party attribution is the member's latest stored affiliation, not affiliation when support was declared. Existing service/repository/error boundaries and compile-checked SQLx queries remain the integration pattern. No schema changes are needed.
+
+## Shape
+
+Introduce a single `entity_details` feature with two typed service operations. Their output types intentionally differ: MPs expose recent declarations; funders expose aggregates. Do not force both into a sparse bag of optional fields.
+
+```rust
+// domain/models/entity_details.rs: conceptual field sketches; private fields + accessors.
+struct ParliamentMemberId(NonZeroU32); // additionally constrained to PostgreSQL i32 range
+struct FunderId(Uuid);                // parsed once at HTTP boundary
+struct MemberDetails {
+    member: ParliamentMember,
+    declarations: Vec<RecentDeclaration>,
+}
+struct RecentDeclaration {
+    source_id: i32,
+    category_name: String,
+    registered_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
+    entries: Vec<DeclaredFunding>,
+}
+struct DeclaredFunding {
+    funder: Option<FunderReference>,
+    amount: Option<BigDecimal>,
+    currency: Option<String>,
+    payment_type: Option<String>,
+}
+struct FunderReference { id: FunderId, name: String }
+struct FunderDetails {
+    funder: Funder, // extend existing model with required FunderId + optional company number
+    currencies: Vec<CurrencySummary>,
+}
+struct CurrencySummary {
+    currency: Option<String>, // None remains an explicit “Currency unrecorded” section
+    parties: Vec<PartyTotal>,
+    top_recipients: Vec<RecipientTotal>,
+}
+struct FundingTotal {
+    known_amount: Option<BigDecimal>, // SQL SUM; None if all source amounts unknown
+    entry_count: u64,
+    unknown_amount_count: u64,
+}
+struct PartyTotal { party_id: i32, party_name: String, total: FundingTotal }
+struct RecipientTotal { member: ParliamentMember, total: FundingTotal }
+
+trait EntityDetailsService: Clone + Send + Sync + 'static {
+    fn member(&self, id: ParliamentMemberId)
+        -> impl Future<Output = Result<MemberDetails, EntityDetailsError>> + Send;
+    fn funder(&self, id: FunderId)
+        -> impl Future<Output = Result<FunderDetails, EntityDetailsError>> + Send;
+}
+enum EntityDetailsError { NotFound, UnexpectedError(String) }
+struct Service<R> { repository: R }
+// Bodies: not implemented; service owns page limits, not-found policy and error adaptation.
+trait EntityDetailsRepo: Clone + Send + Sync + 'static {
+    fn get_member(&self, id: ParliamentMemberId, recent_limit: u8)
+        -> impl Future<Output = Result<Option<MemberDetails>, EntityDetailsRepoError>> + Send;
+    fn get_funder(&self, id: FunderId, recipient_limit_per_currency: u8)
+        -> impl Future<Output = Result<Option<FunderDetails>, EntityDetailsRepoError>> + Send;
+}
+enum EntityDetailsRepoError { DatabaseError(String), InvalidStoredData(String) }
+```
+
+The complete-page interface hides joins, null handling, grouping and limit policy. Its service boundary remains useful for fixed page policy, typed absence and existing app composition; it must not grow additional orchestration layers. Domain read models carry no Axum, Serde or SQLx row types (boundary-discipline, minimize-reader-load).
+
+`MemberId` already exists but lacks parsing/accessors; prefer evolving that existing wrapper into the typed `ParliamentMemberId` contract rather than keeping two wrappers with equivalent meaning. Expose the same ID accessor to search DTO conversion. Required funder identity goes on existing `Funder`, because every current caller represents a stored search funder; update its constructor and tests in the same wave. Do not manufacture identities or add a name-based detail fallback.
+
+### Storage and aggregate contract
+
+- `outbound/entity_details.rs` implements the repository with `query!` macros and explicit fallible row conversion. Use `sqlx::types::BigDecimal` and the SQLx-enabled timestamp representation at this adapter; convert timestamps to existing Chrono domain conventions.
+- Member identity query distinguishes absent member from an existing member with no declarations. Select the most recent 10 declarations before joining entries: registration date DESC NULLS LAST, source ID DESC. Read entries separately for those declaration IDs, or join the limited CTE with funding entries. Preserve empty declarations and every entry; order entries by stored UUID for deterministic output.
+- Funder identity query distinguishes absent funder from no linked entries. Aggregate funding entries joined through declarations to members, filtered by the exact funder UUID. Group by currency plus party `(party_id, party_name)` for totals, and currency plus member ID for recipients. Never use `DISTINCT`, monetary floats, currency defaults or `COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)`.
+- SQL `SUM(amount)`, `COUNT(*)`, and `COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount IS NULL)` provide each total. Unknown amounts are excluded from the sum and their counts remain visible. Null currency gets its own bucket; display its known-number sum with an explicit missing-currency label.
+- Rank recipients separately per currency, known sum DESC NULLS LAST, Parliament member ID ASC as tie-break. Include at most 10 per currency. Never publish an overall winner across currencies. Party rows use the same deterministic order within each currency.
+- A short read-only repeatable-read transaction encloses identity and detail queries, so an import cannot split one page across snapshots. This is request-local state, not a cache or shared lock.
+- “By party” means support declared by members grouped by their latest stored party. Display that explanation next to the totals. Preserve source funder names without alias resolution. Use “Declared support” and “Top declaring MPs” rather than asserting direct payments to parties.
+
+### Module ownership and HTTP
+
+`domain/models/entity_details.rs` owns IDs/read models; `domain/repositories/entity_details.rs` owns the storage port; `domain/services/entity_details/{interface,error}.rs` plus its parent own page policy. `outbound/entity_details.rs` owns SQL and projection. Existing `inbound/http/handlers.rs` owns response DTOs and routes add `GET /members/{id}` and `GET /funders/{id}`. Extend `AppState<E,D>` and server wiring with the detail service; keep the search service separate.
+
+Add `ApiError::NotFound` mapped to 404. Malformed numeric/UUID paths yield client errors; absent valid IDs yield 404; unexpected storage errors yield the existing generic 500. Search DTOs gain a discriminated identity: MP `member_id`, funder `funder_id`; frontend parsing requires the matching field. Do not expose member database UUIDs.
+
+DTO amount fields are decimal strings or null. Frontend amount formatting operates on decimal strings and preserves precision; it must not convert to JavaScript Number merely to call Intl.NumberFormat. Do not change existing search response field conventions gratuitously.
+
+### Frontend
+
+Move the existing search view into `SearchPage.svelte` with its debounce, URL updates, shortcuts, strictness and cancellation intact. `App.svelte` retains shared shell and chooses SearchPage or separate MemberDetails/FunderDetails views from pathname. Ordinary anchor navigation uses browser history; no client router library is necessary. Ensure deployment serves the app for both detail path families; Vite already supports development fallback.
+
+Search result links wrap the entity name only; `EntityIndicator` tooltip buttons remain siblings. Visually distinguish MP and funder headers with explicit labels and existing Parliament/coin icons, retaining dark backgrounds, Manrope and purple accent. MP content is a dated declaration list with nested funding facts; funder content is currency sections containing party totals and ranked recipients. Recipient and known-funder names are navigable using the same search context.
+
+`lib/entity-details.ts` owns response parsing and abortable fetches. Each detail component has a discriminated loading/ready/not-found/error state, cleanup abort, stale-response guard, timeout and retry. Cancellation must not become an error. Empty declarations and empty funder aggregates are ready states with clear empty messages; missing dates, amounts and funders have explicit labels. Search-only keyboard handlers live with SearchPage, avoiding references to an absent input.
+
+## Synthesis decision
+
+Candidate only; the orchestrator records the chosen base and grafts after comparison.
+
+## Tradeoffs accepted
+
+- Accept native document navigation in exchange for correct Back/new-tab/refresh behavior without introducing a routing framework.
+- Accept per-currency recipient lists in exchange for meaningful ranking without conversion rates or mixed-currency totals.
+- Accept one thin service policy boundary in exchange for preserving existing architecture and future caller consistency.
+
+## Alternatives considered
+
+- A generic tagged `/entities/{kind}/{id}` page API reduces route count but exposes entity branching to all callers and encourages nullable MP/funder fields. Two complete-page operations hide each feature's distinct knowledge better.
+- Returning every funder funding entry and aggregating in the browser gives the API a tiny surface but makes every consumer responsible for decimal arithmetic, null coverage, currency separation and party semantics, while transferring unbounded history.
+- A SPA router with intercepted anchors hides navigation mechanics but adds history and modifier-key policy the native browser already implements; revisit when several more page types need persistent in-memory state.
+
+## Implementation reconciliation
+
+No implementation yet. Record accepted changes here and reconcile affected contracts before handoff.
+
+## Open questions and risks
+
+Can the existing production frontend host provide pathname fallback? If not, choose hash paths consistently before building links; do not ship links that only work under Vite. Are ten recent declarations and ten recipients per currency sufficient for the first feature? Treat these as explicit initial limits, with no pagination claimed.
+
+## Next implementation step
+
+Implement ID propagation and repository projections, then prove duplicate entries, empty declarations, null amounts/dates/currencies, per-currency ranking, exact decimal serialization and missing IDs with SQLx integration fixtures before wiring the pages and checking native navigation in the live browser.
*** End Patch"));

content.text:
[Design candidate](/tmp/exposed-entity-design-sol/design.md)

Recommends two typed detail operations, currency-separated aggregates, exact decimal strings, and native links preserving search context. Includes storage invariants, module ownership, API contracts, UI states, and alternatives.
